1416287687.displaySource:
Devrim nods approvingly at your scratched and spattered armor.

"I've been watching you battle back Maya's forces. Impressive stuff. With a sustained effort like that, we may even be able to resettle the Plaguelands someday."

His optimistic tone becomes tempered by years of war fatigue.

"But I still don't think we've gotten to the bottom of Maya's ambitions in the region. Keep working with Caiatl's Psions to learn what her endgame is with all this Golden Age tech."

The sniper gives you a jaunty salute. "Keep up the good work, Guardian."

1423305584.flavorText: Sometimes we don't see what we have to offer, but I tell you: everyone else sees.

1423305585.flavorText: It's more than just a Sparrow.

1423305587.flavorText: Fully optimized for speed above all else—including safety. Recommended for Guardian use only.

1423305589.flavorText: Some things need to be broken.

1423305590.flavorText: "The only problem with a Sparrow this beautiful is that I'm usually going too fast for people to appreciate it." —Cron-8

1423305591.flavorText: This Sparrow, like the Dawning, bears hidden truths and unexpected triumphs.

1423305598.flavorText: Open the doors and bring in the light.

1423305599.flavorText: "It combines my two favorite things: shiny stuff, and sharp stuff." —Ariadne Gris

1423524548.flavorText: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay
